listing.name: Sprog's Quickships
listing.summary: Adds a variety of custom-built, high-impact ships with dramatic visual and combat designs.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a variety of custom-built, high-impact ships with dramatic visual and combat designs.

description:
SpoilerThis little mod adds some various custom made ships to the game, they are:

The Ark Royal

A monstrous piece of ship engineering, This beast of a heavy capital ship is rather OP, But can be taken down if it comes into contact with a large fleet. It features:

19 Assault Chainguns for a broadside rampage

4 Heavy Machine Guns for defense against strike craft

2 Light Dual Machine Guns for Point Defense against incoming missiles

1 Frontal Hardpoint mounted Hellbore Cannon for a massive kick to flux-hampered cruisers and capital ships

14 Pilum LRM Launchers to help with Long Range bombardment

The lack of PD systems and any form of shield leave it very vulnerable to carrier groups and bomber squadrons, So be weary! This beast has it's flaws!

aiDescription: Adds a variety of custom-built, high-impact ships to the game, including a heavily armed capital ship with broadside assault guns and long-range launchers. Designed for dramatic, over-the-top combat scenarios with a focus on visual spectacle and powerful offensive capabilities. Ships are intended for use in custom campaigns or as standalone additions.
